stories.title: Zuid-Korea eist excuses van Kyiv na schending geheimhoudingsverdrag over Noord-Koreaanse gevangenen

en.title: South Korea demands apology from Kyiv after breach of confidentiality agreement on North Korean prisoners
en.summary: South Korea is demanding an apology from Ukraine following Ukraine's violation of a confidentiality agreement concerning North Korean prisoners.

stories.title: Mensen met erfenis gaan vaker verhuizen of kiezen voor zonnepanelen

en.title: People with inheritances move more often or choose solar panels
en.summary: Individuals who inherit 50,000 euros or more after losing their last parent are more likely to relocate or invest in solar panels, according to statistics bureau data.

stories.title: Minister betreurt besluit Israël om status Nederlandse diplomaten in te trekken

en.title: Minister regrets Israel's decision to revoke status of Dutch diplomats
en.summary: The Dutch Foreign Minister expressed strong regret over Israel's decision to withdraw the official status of Dutch diplomats stationed on the West Bank.

stories.title: Kabinet vindt uitzetten van Nederlandse diplomaten door Israël 'onnodig'

en.title: Cabinet considers Israel's expulsion of Dutch diplomats 'unnecessary'
en.summary: The Netherlands views Israel's decision to revoke the status of Dutch diplomats in Ramallah and require their departure within seven days as an unnecessary measure, according to the Foreign Minister.

stories.title: Zuid-Korea eist excuses Kyiv vanwege bekendmaken overdracht Noord-Koreanen

en.title: South Korea demands apologies from Kyiv over disclosure of North Korean transfer
en.summary: South Korea is requesting an apology from Ukraine for publicly announcing the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war, citing a prior agreement to keep the matter confidential.

stories.title: Erfenis wordt ingezet voor groter huis, mét zonnepanelen

en.title: Inheritance used toward larger house with solar panels
en.summary: Someone is using an inheritance to finance the purchase of a larger home that includes solar panels.

stories.title: Betogers verlaten weg in Noord-Ierland na blokkade om omstreden Oranjemars tegen te houden

en.title: Protesters leave road in Northern Ireland after blockade against disputed Orange march
en.summary: Several thousand Catholic residents of Portadown assembled on Sunday to prevent a controversial Protestant march from passing through their neighborhood, with protest leaders planning talks with authorities on Monday.

stories.title: Tegenbetogers van straat, Oranjemars Noord-Ierland hele dag geblokkeerd

en.title: Counter-protesters removed from street, Orange march in Northern Ireland blocked all day
en.summary: In Portadown, Northern Ireland, demonstrators blocked the controversial Orange march on Sunday by occupying Garvaghy Road throughout the day until after midnight, when traffic was able to resume.

stories.title: Zuid-Korea eist excuses na uitspraak Zelensky over Noord-Koreaanse krijgsgevangenen

en.title: South Korea demands apology after Zelensky's statement on North Korean prisoners of war
en.summary: South Korea is demanding an official apology and statement from Ukraine after President Zelensky publicly disclosed that two North Korean prisoners of war were being transferred to South Korea, violating a confidentiality agreement.

stories.title: Israël zet Nederlandse diplomaten uit de Jordaanoever na importverbod

en.title: Israel expels Dutch diplomats from the Jordan Valley following import ban
en.summary: Israel has expelled Dutch diplomats from the Jordan Valley in response to an import ban imposed by the Netherlands.

stories.title: Israël trekt status in van Nederlandse diplomaten op Westoever om importverbod

en.title: Israel revokes diplomatic status of Dutch diplomats in West Bank over import ban
en.summary: Israel has withdrawn diplomatic status from Dutch diplomats in Ramallah following the Netherlands' trade embargo on products from the occupied West Bank. This action follows a similar move in the previous month involving Dutch representatives at an international Gaza support center.

stories.title: Omstreden parade van Oranjemannen in Noord-Ierland geblokkeerd, spanningen in de regering

en.title: Controversial Orange Order parade in Northern Ireland blocked, government tensions rise
en.summary: A controversial parade by the Orange Order in Northern Ireland has been blocked, creating tensions within the government.
